items.title: Ringo's Charlie is a sync-licensing AI assistant within WhatsApp
items.excerpt: Dutch sync-tech startup Ringo has unveiled Charlie, an AI assistant inside WhatsApp that handles sync-licensing requests on top of its AI-powered licensing platform launched in 2025.

items.title: RadioMatic aims to make AI-music a soundtrack for businesses
items.excerpt: A new startup, RadioMatic, launches specifically to supply AI-generated background music to cafes, bars and other businesses, formalising a trend of venues playing AI music.

items.title: AI-powered label PaRa Music says it's identified the next big Indian regional music sub-genre
items.excerpt: Indian label PaRa Music, which uses its in-house AI platform PaRaMeter to analyse audience behaviour and demand patterns to guide investment, says the system has flagged the next breakout regional sub-genre.

items.title: This new plugin lets you generate loops and one-shots from text prompts (Sonura Flow)
items.excerpt: Sonura Flow is a free plugin that generates loops, vocals, one-shots and effects from text prompts inside the DAW, with category selection for drums, bass, melody, pads or vocals.

items.title: Highlights, concerns, and trends from Game Sound Con 2026
items.excerpt: AI was discussed in depth at GameSoundCon; Clean Cuts Interactive's Roc Lee led 'A Frank Discussion About AI for Sound Designers: Different Work, Not Less Work' as game-audio pros weigh generative tools.

items.title: Maono's creator-focused AI-powered microphone, the PD500W, is now available
items.excerpt: After crowdfunding, Maono's PD500W hybrid dynamic mic ships with onboard recording and AI-powered processing features aimed at creators.

items.title: You can now vibe code plugins for your MPC with the help of Akai's official SDK
items.excerpt: Akai's MPC 3.10.1, MPC Sample and Force updates ship the official open SDK, explicitly framed around AI-assisted 'vibe coding' of MPC plugins; Akai's Andy Mac weighs AI coding speed against cutting corners. (Akai open-source plan was covered 10-29; this is the shipping update.)

items.title: Blackstar just gave its ID:X Floor amp modellers Neural Amp Modelling support
items.excerpt: A free update brings NAM A2 Lite neural amp captures to Blackstar's three ID:X Floor units via an expanded Tone 3000 partnership. (Weak: NAM A2 hardware adoption covered 11-08.)

items.title: Nick Cave on AI song-generating platforms: 'An affront to any songwriter'
items.excerpt: Nick Cave calls AI song generators the 'final, most soul-destroying humiliation' for songwriters. (Was an unpublished 11-11 candidate; opinion.)

items.title: Tracktion Waveform Free 14.1 adds AI-powered Mix Analysis
items.excerpt: Waveform Free 14.1's Mix Analysis lets the DAW's AI Assistant examine a project's audio and report loudness, true peak, dynamics, spectral balance and mono compatibility, flagging tracks that muddy the mix.

items.title: ElevenLabs brings free voice restoration to veterans, songwriters, and more patients
items.excerpt: At its NYC Summit ElevenLabs launched free ElevenMusic access for artists who have lost their voice, partnered with Wounded Warrior Project and added NYU Langone to its 1 Million Voices programme.

items.title: What's new in Stable Audio: November 2026 release notes
items.excerpt: Stable Audio adds a project workspace, a Generate app for full tracks and sound effects, a Sampler app for short sample packs, and updates to the beta multitrack Sessions editor.

items.title: Reservoir expands its Suno and Anthropic infringement lawsuits, now seeks nearly $450 million
items.excerpt: Reservoir Media amended its copyright and DMCA complaints, raising allegedly infringed works to 1,368 against Suno and 1,143 against Anthropic and pushing combined statutory damages sought to about $445 million. (New filing; Suno litigation saturated.)

items.title: Influur Pulse 2.0 uses AI to simplify music influencer campaigns
items.excerpt: Influur's AI-powered platform helps artists and labels discover creators, automate song-promotion campaigns and measure results.

items.title: Carmine Appice on using AI to create Cactus music videos
items.excerpt: Veteran drummer Carmine Appice (Vanilla Fudge, Cactus) explains how AI video tools now drive the music videos for his band Cactus.

items.title: AI 노래가 전화 화면까지 들어온다…민티파이 운영사 뮤직플랫, V 컬러링 서비스 시작
items.excerpt: AI 음원 유통 서비스 민티파이(뮤직플랫)가 통신 3사 통화연결 영상 서비스 V 컬러링·V 프로필에 AI 음원을 공급하기 시작했다.

items.title: "AI 목소리라고? 좋기만 한데?"…머무르 노래 음원차트 휩쓸자 편견도 무너졌다
items.excerpt: 인간 기획·작사·작곡에 AI 음성 생성을 결합한 머무르의 '꿈꾸던 어른이 되었나요?'가 음원 차트 2위에 오르고 써클차트 4관왕을 기록하며 AI 보컬 수용 논쟁을 바꾸고 있다.

items.title: 뉴튠 이종필 대표, WIPO AIII 연례 회의서 'AI 생성 콘텐츠 분류 체계' 패널 발표
items.excerpt: AI 음악 스타트업 뉴튠의 이종필 대표가 11월 11일 제네바 WIPO 첫 AI 인프라 연례 회의에서 AI 생성 콘텐츠 분류 체계를 발표한다.

items.title: AI 시대, 저작권 보상 어떻게…'2026 서울 저작권 포럼'
items.excerpt: 문체부와 한국저작권위원회가 12일 '생성형 AI와 저작권'을 주제로 2026 서울 저작권 포럼을 열고 AI 학습 데이터 보상 문제를 논의한다.

items.title: Grimes to make film debut in 'first-ever' AI-generated movie in cinemas
items.excerpt: Grimes voices a lookalike aristocratic character in Gods Don't Give Gifts, billed as the first AI-generated feature in cinemas. (Body date only: 11 November 2026; cross-check movies section.)

items.title: Albanese's love affair with music is on the rocks over AI. Can he write a different tune?
items.excerpt: Opinion: Australia's PM is trying to untangle the AI copyright/TDM knot as the music industry pushes back. (Opinion; IFPI-Australia TDM covered 11-09.)

items.title: Stock tips with a beat: Samsung Securities' AI K-pop group racks up views
items.excerpt: Samsung Securities' AI-generated K-pop girl group LUMINA, which sings investment tips, passed 3 million YouTube views about five weeks after its debut video. (Off-list: on-list Korean outlets had no item.)

items.title: Knxwledge launches streaming service after distributors remove his music without explanation
items.excerpt: Grammy-winning producer Knxwledge launched his own streaming app after distributors pulled records he released years before public AI music tools existed, collateral of the AI-slop takedown wave. (Off-list.)
